## TBR Insight Center™

TBR’s Insight Center™ is a digital-first platform that allows you to curate qualitative and
quantitative insights and collaborate with colleagues in one intuitive platform. Insight Center
contains objective data and intelligence on hundreds of companies, including telecom operators,
cloud providers, systems integrators and management consultancies.
 

Over $3 trillion in proprietary data detailing business-unit levels of revenue, expense, headcount
and margin data is accessible through the powerful visual tools native to Insight Center™.
Additionally, you can compose, configure and curate 100% of TBR’s competitive and market
intelligence research to meet your firm’s needs.
 

[Start Your Free Trial Today][37]

> TBR is the most technologically advanced partner we work with; Insight Center is a game-changer

> table.

> The quality of our Quarterly Business Reviews were all over the map. Some people spent way too
> much time understanding a customer’s financials while others were winging it. Now that TBR

> for us and what they are going to do next quarter.

# Finding Clarity in Chaos

Spend More Time Acting on Competitive Intelligence and Less Time Searching for It

## Who We Serve

##### Executives

Personalized executive briefings deliver strategic insights on:
* Growth Opportunities
* Target Acquisitions
* Financial Reports
* Potential Partners
* Market Innovations

[Learn More »][25] 

##### Product Teams

Product teams save time and money by receiving real-time insights on: 
* Competitor R&D Plans
* Product Roadmaps
* Customer Insights
* Pricing Models
* Market Trends

[Learn More »][26]

##### Intelligence Teams

We help CI teams deliver better intelligence in less time by providing: 
* A custom research portal
* Curated intelligence feeds
* An assigned analyst
* Personalized email briefings
* Ad hoc research support

[Learn More »][27]

##### Marketing Teams

Stay one step ahead of competitors by using our marketing intelligence for: 
* Competitor benchmarking
* Campaign vulnerabilities
* Competitor tactics
* New lead sources
* Content strategy

[Learn More »][28]

[Email Briefings Infographic]

### Customized Email Briefings for Every Stakeholder

We combine smart technology with human curation and analysis to make our email briefings not only
accurate, but also filled with hard-to-find, unpublicized information. This process makes our
briefings concise, targeted and easy to scan because we only push out notifications with critical
information - no nonsense.

Subscribers can customize the companies, topics, categories and products or services that matter
most to them

An assigned analyst who proactively uncovers new competitive threads, innovation trends and emerging
market disruptions

Only the most relevant and critical insights are delivered in each briefing

[Research Portal]

### Research Portal for Ad Hoc Analysis

All of the information we curate and deliver to you in email briefings is tagged and archived in a
custom research portal, which is maintained for you by your assigned analyst. Using this portal, you
can easily search and extract content using more than 100 different categories and filters.

Access not only publicized content, but unpublicized information like competitor sales
presentations, RFPs, pricing sheets and product plans

Built-in collaboration and distribution tools out of the box to add your own commentary and
insights.

Utilize playbooks to easily share insights with colleagues and stakeholders

[Analyst Process]

### Daily Curation by an Assigned Analyst

Our goal is to help you spend more time acting on intelligence and less time searching for it, which
is why we provide every client with an assigned analyst who curates information for you. Other
vendors may claim that they provide an "analyst," but in reality they only provide general customer
support or a help desk.

Your analyst proactively reaches out to discuss changes in your competitive environment and
recommend new companies or topics to track based on what they're seeing.

Contact by phone or email for any questions

Available for ad hoc research requests

## How We're Different in 90 Seconds

#### "Chris, our assigned CI Radar analyst, provides a daily summarized briefing of everything we
#### need to read each morning, without wasting our time on junk or irrelevant items. And the
#### briefings contain items we just can't find ourselves."

Managing Director, Computer Manufacturer

FAQ

## Frequently asked questions

Is the free plan really free? No credit card?
Yes, completely free. You can create a profile, start posting (up to 20 posts), and appear in the
community feed without entering any payment information. You only pay when you upgrade to a Growth
or Scale plan.
How does the automatic website work?
When you upgrade to a paid plan, Easyfie generates a professional website using your existing posts
and profile. You choose a template, connect your domain, and your content is automatically organised
and published. New posts also appear on your website instantly.
Can I use my own domain name?
Yes. Growth and Scale plans include custom domain support. You can connect your existing domain or
we can help you set one up. Hosting is fully managed and included — no extra fees.
What types of businesses is Easyfie best for?
Easyfie works for any local or online business — retail shops, salons, freelancers, photographers,
consultants, restaurants, and more. If you sell products, offer services, or want to build a
following, Easyfie is built for you.
Can I cancel my plan at any time?
Yes, there are no long-term contracts. Cancel any time and your account reverts to the free plan at
the end of your billing cycle. Your posts and profile data are always kept safe.

# Gain Actionable Global Trade Insights with Global Trade Tracker

## Global Trade Tracker: the most powerful suite of trade data analysis tools on the planet.

Global Trade Tracker: built for commodity trade analysts – made in Switzerland.

## Why use Global Trade Tracker?

For [competitive intelligence][36] or [market research][37]; for [predictive modelling][38] or
[evaluating new markets][39], the Global Trade Tracker suite of tools puts you in charge.

One data repository. Five interfaces. Within just hours of receipt, data is already available for
searching on GTT. This means that you will be the first to know.

## Your Subscription – Your Choice

GTT offers you a wide range of different pricing models, from pay-per-report transactional, through
to all-you-can-eat subscription, as well as a selection of hybrid models.

Subscribe to the commodities and countries that you use most, and still have access to all other
commodities and countries on a pay-as-you-go basis. We will match you with the model that offers
best value for your research needs.

[ READ ON... ][40]

## The Harmonized System for Commodity Coding

By using the harmonized system classification coding covering thousands of unique products and
commodities, the Global Trade Tracker toolset tells you what’s really happening in your markets. GTT
covers 99% of the world’s official trade statistics, to the most detailed levels available.

Working in partnership with the official sources of the national data for each country, GTT verifies
and reconciles the data, aligning the different reporting methodologies into unified formats, so
that you can accurately research, compare, analyse, and forecast.

GTT also gives subscribers the most powerful HS Code Lookup tool (probably) in the galaxy. Drill
down through the hierarchies deep into country-specific tariff-level codes. Search multilingually
for commodities and countries; use thesauri to suggest alternatives; and filter by HS edition.

A cut-down [HS lookup tool ][41]on this website allows you to quickly see which HS codes would cover
the commodities of most interest to you.

[ READ ON... ][42]

## Mirror mirror on the wall, who is the fairest of them all?

Not only does Global Trade Tracker give you more reporting countries than any other service, but you
can also flip the report to look at the tradeflows from the partner countries perspective – as if
looking in a mirror.

In this way, the suppressed information is revealed; as well as the tradeflows for non-reporting
countries. The powerful Compare button even allows you to look at the reported and the reflected
tradeflows side by side.

For every single country – Reporters and Partners – the pre-aggregated mirror country is offered as
part of your subscription.

[ READ ON... ][43]

## Global Trade Tracker for Predictive Modelling

The depth and breadth of GTT’s data repositories means better predictive models and improved trend
analysis. For each of the 200+ countries covered by GTT, you will typically have access to 20 years
of archival tradeflow data. And in some cases for the world’s primary economies, we take you all the
way back to 1988; the very beginning of “harmonized system classification” time.

[ READ ON... ][44]

## Global Trade Tracker for Competitive Intelligence

Improve your strategic decisions by understanding your markets, and take advantage of the business
opportunities. The GTT suite of tools gives you both flexibility and power so that you can analyse
the tradeflows of your products from any angle. With GTT, you become the instant expert. Drill down
through the product commodity trees with ease, and explode entire economic areas with a single
click. Benchmark your import/export data against the total market, so that you can judge the
opportunities in a global context.

[ READ ON... ][45]

## Global Trade Tracker for Policy Decision Support

Build confidence in your business strategies, and keep track of changing trade policies. Track
detailed tariff-level tradeflow data on GTT. Only GTT gives you the granularity and detail to be
able to track the changes and pick the winners. Set up unlimited search profiles that automatically

and reconciles the data, aligning the different reporting methodologies into unified formats, so
that you can accurately research, compare, analyse, and forecast.

GTT also gives subscribers the most powerful HS Code Lookup tool (probably) in the galaxy. Drill
down through the hierarchies deep into country-specific tariff-level codes. Search multilingually
for commodities and countries; use thesauri to suggest alternatives; and filter by HS edition.

A cut-down [HS lookup tool ][41]on this website allows you to quickly see which HS codes would cover
the commodities of most interest to you.

[ READ ON... ][42]

## Mirror mirror on the wall, who is the fairest of them all?

Not only does Global Trade Tracker give you more reporting countries than any other service, but you
can also flip the report to look at the tradeflows from the partner countries perspective – as if
looking in a mirror.

In this way, the suppressed information is revealed; as well as the tradeflows for non-reporting
countries. The powerful Compare button even allows you to look at the reported and the reflected
tradeflows side by side.

For every single country – Reporters and Partners – the pre-aggregated mirror country is offered as
part of your subscription.

[ READ ON... ][43]

## Global Trade Tracker for Predictive Modelling

The depth and breadth of GTT’s data repositories means better predictive models and improved trend
analysis. For each of the 200+ countries covered by GTT, you will typically have access to 20 years
of archival tradeflow data. And in some cases for the world’s primary economies, we take you all the
way back to 1988; the very beginning of “harmonized system classification” time.

[ READ ON... ][44]

## Global Trade Tracker for Competitive Intelligence

Improve your strategic decisions by understanding your markets, and take advantage of the business
opportunities. The GTT suite of tools gives you both flexibility and power so that you can analyse
the tradeflows of your products from any angle. With GTT, you become the instant expert. Drill down
through the product commodity trees with ease, and explode entire economic areas with a single
click. Benchmark your import/export data against the total market, so that you can judge the
opportunities in a global context.

[ READ ON... ][45]

## Global Trade Tracker for Policy Decision Support

Build confidence in your business strategies, and keep track of changing trade policies. Track
detailed tariff-level tradeflow data on GTT. Only GTT gives you the granularity and detail to be
able to track the changes and pick the winners. Set up unlimited search profiles that automatically
look for significant changes in tradeflows. Define triggers that alert you as soon as changes occur.
Integrate GTT into your data visualisation tools to easily confirm that you’re on the right track.

[ READ ON... ][46]

## Global Trade Tracker for Market Research

Know your markets to maintain your competitiveness, and protect your business. GTT gives you the
tools to stay ahead of the competition. Knowing and understanding your existing markets is the
foundation stone of good business. Use Global Trade Tracker to look at tradeflow changes in related
commodities and countries to be fully prepared for challenges ahead.

[ READ ON... ][47]

## Global Trade Tracker for Evaluating New Markets

Discover new opportunities and target markets, and grow your business. GTT gives you the edge that
you need to compete effectively in global markets. Analyse exports to keep track of the competition.
Look at imports to identify potential customers and partners. Compare reporter and partner flows to
uncover the otherwise suppressed and hidden information. Investigate related commodities to discover
growth opportunities.

[ READ ON... ][48]

[Financement][41]

L'obtention de financement peut s'avérer l’une des étapes les plus difficiles pour un entrepreneur.
Nos experts sont là pour vous aider.

[Données de marché et statistiques][42]

Gagnez du temps en faisant appel à nos experts en intelligence d'affaires pour mieux comprendre
votre marché, rester à l’affût des occasions et des tendances et accéder à des données fiables et de
qualité.

[Lancement d'entreprise][43]

Vous songez à démarrer votre propre entreprise, à acheter une entreprise existante ou à prendre la
relève de l'entreprise familiale? Notre équipe de conseillers vous offre un accompagnement
personnalisé pour vous aider à réaliser votre projet.

## NOS SERVICES

[Conseils et orientation][44]

**Grâce à un diagnostic de votre projet et de vos ambitions et à des conseils personnalisés
gratuits**, nos conseillers vous dirigeront vers les meilleures ressources, solutions et sources de
financement pour propulser votre projet, et ce, en fonction de vos objectifs d'affaires.

[Plus d’infos ][45]

[Intelligence d'affaires][46]

Nos experts en intelligence d'affaires exploitent des milliers de données pour produire une
information fiable, gratuite ou à un coût avantageux, à partir de laquelle vous pouvez agir.

[Plus d’infos ][47]

[Conseils d'affaires ][48]

Nous vous mettons en contact avec des conseillers en affaires expérimentés qui sauront vous guider
sur différents aspects de votre projet, et ce, à des prix très concurrentiels.

[Plus d’infos ][49]

[Certification à l'exportation ][50]

Nous aidons les entreprises et les particuliers qui souhaitent mener des activités d’exportation à
certifier leurs documents rapidement et à faible coût.

[Plus d’infos ][51]

## RESSOURCES EN LIGNE

Accédez à plus de [2 000 ressources en ligne][52] et à des outils pratiques et gratuits pour
orienter vos démarches et vous permettre de passer à la prochaine étape de votre projet avec succès.

## PRODUITS VEDETTES

[Répertoires d’organismes régionaux][53]

Trouvez les organismes pouvant soutenir votre projet d’affaires où que vous soyez au Québec.

[Financement ][54]

Découvrez les sources de financement disponibles selon votre projet d’affaires.

[Programmes de soutien et services][55]

Accédez aux programmes de soutien et services dont vous disposez pour réussir votre projet.

[Accélérateurs et incubateurs][56]

Découvrez les incubateurs et les accélérateurs pouvant contribuer à la réussite de votre projet de
lancement ou de croissance d’entreprise.

[Concours et bourses][57]

Participez à des concours pour financer et promouvoir votre projet, rencontrer des experts et
réseauter.

[Formations en démarrage][58]

Choisissez le parcours de formation convenant le mieux à votre projet.

[Vendre aux gouvernements][59]

Obtenez des renseignements sur les occasions d’affaires et les procédures de soumission aux marchés
publics.

[Répertoires spécialisés][60]

Consultez ces répertoires de ressources destinées à des clientèles spécifiques et à la mise en œuvre
de modèles d’affaires de transition.

[Événements et occasions d’affaires][61]

Voyez les appels de candidatures, les missions commerciales, les concours et les événements offerts
partout dans la province.

[Contactez-nous][62]

## Using AI in sales doesn’t have to be hard.

workaround. Salesmotion replaces the chaos with account intelligence agents built for how sales
teams actually work.

* Time consuming — Hours of prompting, copying, and pasting per account
* Hard to manage — No shared context, every rep does it differently
* Impossible to scale — Works for 5 accounts, breaks at 500
* Inconsistent quality — Different prompts, different results every time
* Hallucination risk — No source verification, can’t trust the output
* Still manual verification — You end up checking everything anyway
* Stale data — Training cutoffs mean you’re working with yesterday’s news
* Not proactive — Nothing happens until you go look

* Works standalone — No complex implementation or integration required
* Any industry — From SaaS to pharma to financial services

## Shadow monitors and executes. You approve.

Shadow delivers a continuous intelligence feed calibrated to your listening plan, and surfaces the
signals that matter. One surface across media, search, social, and AI.

When a signal warrants action, Shadow produces the work. Pitch drafts, content calendar updates,
award submissions, and media lists built from live coverage data. Review. Approve. Ship.

Shadow reads the narrative landscape across media, search, social, and AI, continuously. Daily
signals feed a compounding narrative graph that surfaces what's forming, what's accelerating, and
what to act on each day.

## TBR Insight Center™

TBR’s Insight Center™ is a digital-first platform that allows you to curate qualitative and
quantitative insights and collaborate with colleagues in one intuitive platform. Insight Center
contains objective data and intelligence on hundreds of companies, including telecom operators,
cloud providers, systems integrators and management consultancies.
 

Over $3 trillion in proprietary data detailing business-unit levels of revenue, expense, headcount
and margin data is accessible through the powerful visual tools native to Insight Center™.
Additionally, you can compose, configure and curate 100% of TBR’s competitive and market
intelligence research to meet your firm’s needs.
 

[Start Your Free Trial Today][37]

> TBR is the most technologically advanced partner we work with; Insight Center is a game-changer

> table.

> financials, but they need to understand what the priorities and strategies are of the GSIs, what’s

[**Zyns**][11] are becoming one of the most popular modern nicotine products worldwide. They belong
to a category called **oral nicotine pouches**, which are designed as a **smoke-free and
tobacco-free alternative** to cigarettes and vaping.

Many users search questions like [**what are zyns**][12], **are zyns bad for you**, **how much are
zyns**, and **do zyns cause cancer**. This article explains everything in a clear, structured, and
SEO-friendly way.

## **What Are Zyns?**

**Zyns** are small white nicotine pouches placed between the **upper lip and gum**. They do not
contain tobacco leaf. Instead, they include:
* **Nicotine powder**
* **Flavoring agents**
* **Plant-based fillers**

Once placed in the mouth, nicotine is absorbed through the gums into the bloodstream. Unlike
cigarettes, Zyns produce **no smoke and no vapor**, making them discreet and easy to use.

## **Zyns Meaning**

The **Zyns meaning** refers to a brand of [**oral nicotine pouch product**][13] designed for
nicotine delivery without smoking or vaping. Over time, “Zyns” has become a general term used for
nicotine pouches in many regions.

## **What Do Zyns Do?**

**Zyns** deliver nicotine into the body through oral absorption. Users may experience:
* **Mild stimulation**
* **Temporary relaxation**
* **Increased focus**
* **Nicotine craving satisfaction**

However, these effects are caused by **nicotine**, which is a highly addictive substance.

## **How Do Zyns Work?**

**Zyns work through a simple process:**
1. A pouch is placed under the **upper lip**
2. Saliva activates the pouch
3. Nicotine is released slowly
4. Nicotine is absorbed through the **oral tissues**

Effects usually begin within minutes and gradually increase.

## **How Long Do Zyns Last?**

**A single Zyn pouch typically lasts between:**
* **20 to 60 minutes**

Duration depends on:
* **Nicotine strength**
* **User tolerance**
* **Flavor type**
* **Saliva production**

After use, the pouch is disposed of.

## **Zyns Flavors**

**Zyns flavors are one of the main reasons for their popularity. Common options include:**
* **Black Cherry Zyns** – Sweet cherry flavor
* **Cool Mint** – Strong cooling sensation
* **Spearmint** – Smooth mint taste
* **Citrus** – Tangy lemon-like flavor
* **Coffee** – Mild coffee aroma
* **Wintergreen** – Herbal mint freshness

These flavors are designed to provide variety and appeal.

## **Are Zyns Bad for You?**

**Yes, Zyns can be harmful because they contain nicotine, which is addictive. Even though they are
smoke-free, they may:**
* Cause **nicotine addiction**
* Increase **heart rate**
* Affect **brain development in youth**
* Lead to **long-term dependence**

Health experts strongly warn that nicotine use is unsafe for teenagers and young adults.

## **Do Zyns Cause Cancer?**

**Currently, there is no confirmed evidence that Zyns directly cause cancer. However:**
* Long-term studies are still ongoing
* Nicotine itself is not classified as a carcinogen
* Other ingredients and oral exposure effects are still being researched

So, while cancer risk is not proven, long-term safety is still uncertain.

## **Do Zyns Cause Gum Cancer?**

**There is no strong scientific evidence linking Zyns directly to gum cancer. However, frequent use
may lead to:**
* Gum irritation
* Mouth dryness
* Gum recession
* Oral sensitivity

Dentists recommend caution and proper oral hygiene.

## **Are Zyns Better Than Vaping?**

**Both products contain nicotine, but they work differently.**

### **Zyns**
* No smoke or vapor
* No lung exposure
* Discreet use

### **Vaping**
* Fast nicotine delivery
* Inhalation-based
* Higher lung exposure risk

👉 Neither is completely safe because both contain **addictive nicotine**.

## **Zyns Price – How Much Are Zyns?**

**The Zyns price varies depending on:**
* Country
* Store type
* Nicotine strength

**Generally:**
* Sold per can
* Imported versions cost more
* Bulk purchases reduce cost per unit

So, **how much do Zyns cost** depends on location and availability.

## **How Many Zyns Should I Have a Day?**

**There is no safe medical dose for Zyns. However:**
* Light users: **1–3 pouches per day**
* Regular users: higher frequency use

More usage increases **nicotine addiction risk**.

## **Can You Bring Zyns on a Plane?**

**Yes, in most countries, Zyns are allowed on planes, but:**
* Must be in **carry-on or checked luggage**
* Quantity may be restricted
* Only for **personal use**

Always check airline regulations before travel.

## **How Old Do You Have to Be to Buy Zyns?**

**Most regions require users to be:**
* **18+ or 21+ years old**

This restriction exists due to the **addictive nature of nicotine**.

Our reputation rests on one rule: we test tools on real projects before we recommend them. Here’s

02

03

out.

04

FAQ

## Frequently asked questions

Is the free plan really free? No credit card?
Yes, completely free. You can create a profile, start posting (up to 20 posts), and appear in the
community feed without entering any payment information. You only pay when you upgrade to a Growth
or Scale plan.
How does the automatic website work?
When you upgrade to a paid plan, Easyfie generates a professional website using your existing posts
and profile. You choose a template, connect your domain, and your content is automatically organised
and published. New posts also appear on your website instantly.
Can I use my own domain name?
Yes. Growth and Scale plans include custom domain support. You can connect your existing domain or
we can help you set one up. Hosting is fully managed and included — no extra fees.
What types of businesses is Easyfie best for?
Easyfie works for any local or online business — retail shops, salons, freelancers, photographers,
consultants, restaurants, and more. If you sell products, offer services, or want to build a
following, Easyfie is built for you.
Can I cancel my plan at any time?
Yes, there are no long-term contracts. Cancel any time and your account reverts to the free plan at
the end of your billing cycle. Your posts and profile data are always kept safe.

# Gain Actionable Global Trade Insights with Global Trade Tracker

## Global Trade Tracker: the most powerful suite of trade data analysis tools on the planet.

Global Trade Tracker: built for commodity trade analysts – made in Switzerland.

## Why use Global Trade Tracker?

For [competitive intelligence][36] or [market research][37]; for [predictive modelling][38] or
[evaluating new markets][39], the Global Trade Tracker suite of tools puts you in charge.

One data repository. Five interfaces. Within just hours of receipt, data is already available for
searching on GTT. This means that you will be the first to know.

## Your Subscription – Your Choice

GTT offers you a wide range of different pricing models, from pay-per-report transactional, through
to all-you-can-eat subscription, as well as a selection of hybrid models.

Subscribe to the commodities and countries that you use most, and still have access to all other
commodities and countries on a pay-as-you-go basis. We will match you with the model that offers
best value for your research needs.

[ READ ON... ][40]

## The Harmonized System for Commodity Coding

By using the harmonized system classification coding covering thousands of unique products and
commodities, the Global Trade Tracker toolset tells you what’s really happening in your markets. GTT
covers 99% of the world’s official trade statistics, to the most detailed levels available.

Working in partnership with the official sources of the national data for each country, GTT verifies
and reconciles the data, aligning the different reporting methodologies into unified formats, so
that you can accurately research, compare, analyse, and forecast.

GTT also gives subscribers the most powerful HS Code Lookup tool (probably) in the galaxy. Drill
down through the hierarchies deep into country-specific tariff-level codes. Search multilingually
for commodities and countries; use thesauri to suggest alternatives; and filter by HS edition.

A cut-down [HS lookup tool ][41]on this website allows you to quickly see which HS codes would cover
the commodities of most interest to you.

[ READ ON... ][42]

## Mirror mirror on the wall, who is the fairest of them all?

Not only does Global Trade Tracker give you more reporting countries than any other service, but you
can also flip the report to look at the tradeflows from the partner countries perspective – as if
looking in a mirror.

In this way, the suppressed information is revealed; as well as the tradeflows for non-reporting
countries. The powerful Compare button even allows you to look at the reported and the reflected
tradeflows side by side.

For every single country – Reporters and Partners – the pre-aggregated mirror country is offered as
part of your subscription.

[ READ ON... ][43]

## Global Trade Tracker for Predictive Modelling

The depth and breadth of GTT’s data repositories means better predictive models and improved trend
analysis. For each of the 200+ countries covered by GTT, you will typically have access to 20 years
of archival tradeflow data. And in some cases for the world’s primary economies, we take you all the
way back to 1988; the very beginning of “harmonized system classification” time.

[ READ ON... ][44]

## Global Trade Tracker for Competitive Intelligence

Improve your strategic decisions by understanding your markets, and take advantage of the business
opportunities. The GTT suite of tools gives you both flexibility and power so that you can analyse
the tradeflows of your products from any angle. With GTT, you become the instant expert. Drill down
through the product commodity trees with ease, and explode entire economic areas with a single
click. Benchmark your import/export data against the total market, so that you can judge the
opportunities in a global context.

[ READ ON... ][45]

## Global Trade Tracker for Policy Decision Support

Build confidence in your business strategies, and keep track of changing trade policies. Track
detailed tariff-level tradeflow data on GTT. Only GTT gives you the granularity and detail to be
able to track the changes and pick the winners. Set up unlimited search profiles that automatically

relève de l'entreprise familiale? Notre équipe de conseillers vous offre un accompagnement
personnalisé pour vous aider à réaliser votre projet.

gratuits**, nos conseillers vous dirigeront vers les meilleures ressources, solutions et sources de
financement pour propulser votre projet, et ce, en fonction de vos objectifs d'affaires.

information fiable, gratuite ou à un coût avantageux, à partir de laquelle vous pouvez agir.

[Plus d’infos ][47]

[Plus d’infos ][49]

[Plus d’infos ][51]

## Using AI in sales doesn’t have to be hard.

Most teams cobble together ChatGPT, spreadsheets, and browser tabs. That’s not a strategy — it’s a
workaround. Salesmotion replaces the chaos with account intelligence agents built for how sales
teams actually work.

### The DIY Approach
* Time consuming — Hours of prompting, copying, and pasting per account
* Hard to manage — No shared context, every rep does it differently
* Impossible to scale — Works for 5 accounts, breaks at 500
* Inconsistent quality — Different prompts, different results every time
* Hallucination risk — No source verification, can’t trust the output
* Still manual verification — You end up checking everything anyway
* Stale data — Training cutoffs mean you’re working with yesterday’s news
* Not proactive — Nothing happens until you go look

### The Salesmotion Way
* Intuitive UX — Beautiful interface your reps will actually use
* Easy to use — No training, no prompt engineering needed
* Automated workflow — Signal Agent → Research Agent → Outreach Agent, every time
* Live in hours — Plug and play, see value on day one
* No team needed — One person sets it up, entire team benefits
* Works standalone — No complex implementation or integration required
* Any industry — From SaaS to pharma to financial services
* Built for sales — Made by sales experts, for sales experts

**Zyns** are small white nicotine pouches placed between the **upper lip and gum**. They do not
contain tobacco leaf. Instead, they include:
* **Nicotine powder**
* **Flavoring agents**
* **Plant-based fillers**

cigarettes, Zyns produce **no smoke and no vapor**, making them discreet and easy to use.

**Zyns** deliver nicotine into the body through oral absorption. Users may experience:

However, these effects are caused by **nicotine**, which is a highly addictive substance.

* **User tolerance**

* **Saliva production**

After use, the pouch is disposed of.

* **Coffee** – Mild coffee aroma

These flavors are designed to provide variety and appeal.

## **Are Zyns Bad for You?**

**Yes, Zyns can be harmful because they contain nicotine, which is addictive. Even though they are
smoke-free, they may:**
* Cause **nicotine addiction**
* Increase **heart rate**
* Affect **brain development in youth**
* Lead to **long-term dependence**

Health experts strongly warn that nicotine use is unsafe for teenagers and young adults.

## **Do Zyns Cause Cancer?**

**Currently, there is no confirmed evidence that Zyns directly cause cancer. However:**
* Long-term studies are still ongoing
* Nicotine itself is not classified as a carcinogen
* Other ingredients and oral exposure effects are still being researched

So, while cancer risk is not proven, long-term safety is still uncertain.

**There is no strong scientific evidence linking Zyns directly to gum cancer. However, frequent use

* Mouth dryness

* Oral sensitivity

Dentists recommend caution and proper oral hygiene.

**Generally:**
* Sold per can
* Imported versions cost more
* Bulk purchases reduce cost per unit

So, **how much do Zyns cost** depends on location and availability.

**There is no safe medical dose for Zyns. However:**
* Light users: **1–3 pouches per day**
* Regular users: higher frequency use
